case_number: 2024 INSC 503; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No(s). 9091 of 2022)
summary: Corrupt practices via monthly gratification demands; appellant convicted under PC Act s.7 and s.13(1)(d) read with s.13(2); High Court upheld trial court conviction while overturning co-accused's conviction; challenge to proof of bribe demand and acceptance; trap procedure validity examined; inconsistent witness testimony regarding money transfer; forensic evidence (sodium carbonate test) corroborating bribe acceptance; diary entries and memo evidence authenticated; final determination hinged on credibility assessment of prosecution vs defense narratives.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment reversed; appellant acquitted of all charges; conviction set aside.
